audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[0-2].side say Soraka, phases[5-6].side say Sona, but content win[0-2]/win[5-6] and packet.levelChart all say Skill (even) for those rows. Only row 3 (Levels 4-5) agrees between layers, and even there full said Skill while win[3]/packet said Soraka.
audit.why: Content whys[] already correctly describe levels 1-3 and 1st-item/late as even skill duels between two enablers, and levels 4-5 as Soraka-favored because Sona runs out of mana double-spending auras and Power Chord — the full layer's side/rating had simply drifted from that.
audit.corrected: phases[0,1,2,5,6].side moved to Skill and phases[3].side moved to Soraka, all with matching rating/why; win[] left untouched since it already agreed.

audit.why: First-item and level-6 spikes correctly track spikes[1]/[2] — Crescendo as her lane-winning threat at 6, sustain-vs-haste at first back.

audit.whatIsWrong: None of the writable fields mention Sona's on-hit Hymn of Valor (Q) scaling with attack speed, the Power Chord/Hymn auto-reset tell, or that Aria of Perseverance (W) shields on cast and should be baited before committing burst — all three are in missingInteractions for this matchup.
audit.why: Hymn of Valor applies on-hit effects, so raw armor undervalues the trade if she's stacked attack speed. Power Chord empowers her 3rd cast into a bonus-damage auto — the wind-up auto is the real tell. Aria's shield changes all-in math if it's already up.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns rewritten with real numbers plus the auto-reset tell; dontsFull[2].d rewritten to cover on-hit Q; breakdown.spikes rewritten to cover the shield-bait timing.
